title: C02 Catalog SSG + ISR

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: The product listing and detail routes are statically generated: generateStaticParams enumerates the seeded product slugs and the reference solution serves static HTML for those routes after `next build` (QA: SSG pages are prerendered at build time and served as static HTML).

A revalidate window is configured so the page demonstrably serves stale-then-fresh content on the documented schedule (QA: ISR revalidation serves stale content and then updates within the declared window).

The dynamicParams true|false gotcha is demonstrated and documented: a slug that was NOT pre-rendered behaves per the configured dynamicParams setting (renders on-demand vs 404), with the contrast explained in NOTES.md / spec.md.
The challenge reads product data only through a local _lib helper that wraps the frozen lib/data repository — it does not edit lib/data and does not import another challenge's files.

The c02 _meta folder contains spec.md (with non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers, including a committed cache-flow note for the ISR caching behaviour), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts (QA: every challenge has committed spec + Defend-It).
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
